member.name: T:TimeMachine.Program
member.summary: Automated test runner for the TimeMachine module. Replaces the previous interactive REPL that blocked on Console.ReadLine() and made the module impossible to validate non-interactively.
member.remarks: Each test is a parameterless function returning a (pass, message) pair. Tests aim for sub-second runtime and avoid real wall-clock waits where possible: clock semantics are exercised directly through and by manually firing ticks, with only a handful of integration tests spinning the 's background loop.
